notes.title: 3.28 Version Update Announcement [0.4.1]
notes.content:
Optimization Updates

1. New Addition: [Scholarly Clans] Module
During each game, a random scholarly clan will be generated around the city. You can persuade them to support your faction and provide additional assistance, such as sending reinforcements, providing financial and food support, recommending military generals, and adjusting attributes.
2. New Addition: [Trading] Module
If the city has a supportive scholarly clan, food and grass trading can be conducted within the city to alleviate resource shortages during special times.
3. New Addition: [Culture] Module
Cultural points can be obtained through scholarly clans and the construction of special buildings called [Ancestral Temples] to develop cultural attributes. Culture can provide new attribute support for the faction.
4. New Addition: [General Traits]
At the beginning of each game, all generals will be randomly assigned a trait, such as immunity to capture, immunity to death in battle, providing technological points for the faction, increasing personal attributes, etc., adding more variations to each game.
5. Addition of 51 New Military Generals
These generals can only be recruited through recommendations from scholarly clans.
6. Addition of a New Scenario: The Battle of Guan Du in 200 AD.
7. Addition of a New Lobby Background.

Balance Adjustments
1. In the 189 Scenario, the initial military generals of the neutral forces in the Jiangnan region have been increased by 3 orange-ranked generals.

notes.title: 0.3.2 Version Update Announcement
notes.content:
Update Content:

Optimization
1. Open Diplomacy 2.0 version, open 1V1 mode of diplomacy content. Through diplomacy, you can show kindness to other forces, invite attacks, and declare ceasefire.
2. Added text chat function to custom rooms for convenient communication while waiting in the room.
3. Re-arranged the position of the "Menu" button to make it more prominent.
4. Optimized the button style of the avatar on the upper right of the king date to make it easier to conduct diplomatic negotiations by clicking on the avatar of the monarch.
5. Added right-click operation description text to the interface for easier operation of quickly deploying and recalling generals.
6. Added right-click operation description text to the interface for group organization to make it easier to familiarize with individual grouping and disbanding generals.
7. Optimized the logic of AI defense, now AI will not move generals to a city upon attack.
8. Optimized the logic of AI attack, now AI will find nearby cities to deploy troops from.

Bug Fixes
1. Fixed a bug that may cause one's generals to have 0 soldiers stationed in allied cities (added an exception detection mechanism, if such a situation is detected, the abnormal general will automatically return to one's own city).
2. Special handling has been implemented for the prisoner interface to avoid it not popping up when concurrently used (how many times has this been fixed? I hope this time it has completely solved the problem).
3. Fixed MACOS not being able to use the Enter key to bring up the chat box.
4. Fixed issues with Jiangzhou and Brazil voice not correspondingly modified.
5. Fixed the issue of Yan Yan's troops being depicted as cavalry.
6. Fixed a bug that may cause generals' attributes to decrease after Huang Yueying's death.
7. Redesigned the logic of aura skills to avoid new bugs caused by similar skills like Huang Yueying's.

Balance Adjustments
1. The copper coins required for building level 1 arrow towers have been reduced from 2500 to 2000.
2. The maximum number of reserves has been increased for level 1 barracks from 1500 to 1000, and at the same time, the number of reserves increased from levels 2-5 has been reduced accordingly.
3. The order of technological advancements for city construction has been adjusted, with "Corner Tower" and "Crossbow Tower" moved to be the third and seventh technologies in city construction respectively.

notes.title: Update Content for Version 2024.1.26
notes.content:
Update Content:

Optimization-related Changes:

1.Opened Diplomacy Version 1.0, introducing diplomatic features for 2v2 and 4v4 modes. Through diplomacy, players can now request resources from allies and mark attack and defense routes.
2.Added a teammate chat function in-game, allowing for text chat in 2v2 and 4v4 modes. The chat box can be accessed using the Enter key, facilitating communication during battles.
3.Added a fullscreen mode option. For users with unconventional resolutions who are unable to switch from windowed mode back to fullscreen mode, they can now directly return to fullscreen mode through this setting.
4.Fixed a geographical error by swapping the locations of the Jiangzhou and Brazil cities.
5.Introduced a new Fortress Construction technology, comprehensively enhancing city defense capabilities. Originally planned as a separate system, considering the already significant amount of gameplay in the current version, it was decided to simplify the gameplay and operations, thus releasing it as a branch of technology.
6.Added a new policy: "Unbreakable." The number of technology points and copper coins consumed for researching Fortress Construction technology is reduced by half.
7.Added TIPS descriptions to the top right corner for faction comparisons.
8.Added TIPS descriptions to menu buttons.

Bug Fixes:

1.Fixed a bug where allies stationed in a city affected by Decisive Battle radiation were not processed, causing units to become stuck in that city.
2.Fixed a bug where frequent city switching and troop replenishment could result in a prompt indicating full troop capacity despite no actual troop formation.
3.Implemented special handling for potential issues with the captive interface not popping up, ensuring it can always be accessed.
4.Fixed a bug that could potentially prevent the game from ending.
5.Attempted to optimize the lagging issues experienced in the later stages of the game on macOS.
6.Fixed a bug where clicking to observe a battle could cause the game to freeze.

Balance Adjustments:

1. the passive skill "Self-Destruct" from the five generals Hua Xiong, Gao Lan, Yuan Shao, Xu Huang, and Han Dang, replacing it with "Consecutive Strike."
2.Substantially reduced the durability and attack power added to cities by archer towers.
3.Increasing city scale no longer increases durability.
4.Increased the base production of money and food in cities and improved the bonus to production from city scale. The production bonus for the main city is now higher than that of branch cities.

notes.title: 2024.1.11 Version Update Content
notes.content:
This update includes:

Feature optimizations
1、Optimized art style for scenes, updated with a new map style and battlefield style
2、Added a display of "commission status" and "special buildings" to the left city list, making it easier to quickly check the status of your own city
3、Added a new friend adding feature to the custom room. You can use the left mouse button to bring up the menu and send Steam friend requests
4、When operating in the game now, clicking ESC will no longer bring up the system menu interface. You can only bring it up by clicking the menu button with the mouse
5、Added a new initial wild general setting to the custom room. You can choose from several settings including random wild, must have 1 gold, must have 1 red, must have 1 orange
6、Added a new feature to switch perspectives. You can use the buttons 【PgUp】or 【+】on the small keyboard, 【PgDn】or 【-】on the small keyboard to zoom in or out of the map view. When zooming out, a special building icon indicating what can be built in the city will be displayed above the city, but no operations除了拖动地图以外的任何操作都不允许进行。
7、The initial 3 wild generals will no longer be stacked together for display
8、Added a small tip to the loading interface
9、Added two new resolution options: 2880*1800 and 2560*1600

BUG FIXES
1、Fixed a bug where in some cases, the attacker would be judged as defeated immediately after the siege began.
2、Fixed a bug where some generals who were beheaded would reappear as wild generals.
3、Fixed a bug that would cause the game to go black if the Windows taskbar was on the right side when the game was launched in windowed mode.
4、Fixed a bug where allied reinforcements wouldn't participate in the battle and would get stuck in the city when the city was under attack and multiple forces were involved.
5、Fixed a bug where the prisoner interface might not appear under certain circumstances.
6、Fixed a bug where other cities belonging to the same force as the destroyed force would be extinguished directly and all other generals from that force would return to their home cities with 0 soldiers.
7、Fixed a bug where the logic for country extinction might not be triggered when the number of cities belonging to a force reached 0.
8、Fixed a bug where when generals were manually dragged during formation change, other windows would pop up, causing the selected general to move to the upper left corner.
9、Fixed a bug where generals in the wild might not be recruitable and would display a "failure" prompt under certain circumstances.
10、Fixed a bug where generals who had already been recruited would still display their wild portraits and a "can't recruit duplicate generals" prompt would appear when clicked under certain circumstances.

Balance Adjustment
1、Policy-related adjustments
【Infantry Counter】: The damage increase against infantry per level of the policy is reduced from 10% to 5%.
【Archer Counter】: The damage increase against archers per level of the policy is reduced from 10% to 5%.
【Cavalry Counter】: The damage increase against cavalry per level of the policy is reduced from 10% to 5%.
【Militarism】: The overall troop damage increase per level of the policy is reduced from 5% to 3%.
【Rising Country】: The reduction of administrative technology points is adjusted to halve the points and halve the cost of copper coins.
2、Technology-related adjustments
The overall amount of copper coins consumed for technology research is reduced, making it easier to upgrade technologies.
【Drumbeat Call】: The damage increase of infantry's rage skill is reduced from 50% to 30%.
【Crossbow】: The damage increase of archers' rage skill is reduced from 50% to 30%.
【All-out Assault】: The damage increase of cavalry's rage skill is reduced from 50% to 30%.
3、The mutual restraint coefficient between unit types is adjusted from 25% to 15%.
4、Skill damage coefficient adjustments
The normal attack damage of orange and higher-tier cavalry units is adjusted from 75% to 90%.
The damage coefficient of 【Volley4】 and 【Fire Arrow4】 is adjusted from 156% to 146%.
The damage coefficient of 【Pike4】 and 【Ambush4】 is adjusted from 156% to 146%.
The damage coefficient of 【Charge4】 and 【Flanking4】 is adjusted from 230% to 210%.
The damage coefficient of 【Charge3】 and 【Flanking3】 is adjusted from 205% to 195%.
The damage coefficient of 【Torrent Crossbow】is adjusted from 115% to 156%.
5、The initial attributes of green, blue, and purple generals are strengthened. Blue generals now have a passive skill. Purple generals' normal attacks are now consistent with orange generals. The growth rate of green generals is increased from 5 to 6, blue generals from 6 to 7, and purple generals from 7 to 7.5.
6、Scenario balance optimization: In the 189 scenario, Taishi Ci is removed from the Kong Rong faction. Yan Xing cannot be used, and Yan Xing's initial cities are adjusted to 2. Wuwei now belongs to Guo Si. Gu Yong in Jiujian and Wu Ju in Yuzhang have switched positions.

Due to the extensive player interaction involved in the diplomacy module, it requires a significant amount of testing, optimization, and balance adjustments. Therefore, its release will be delayed. We kindly ask for your understanding and appreciate your support!

notes.title: 2023.12.28 Version Update
notes.content:
This update includes the following changes:
1.Fixed a bug that would prompt "failure" when clicking on buildings under certain circumstances.
2.Fixed a bug that would prompt "failure" when clicking on free under certain circumstances.
3.Fixed a bug where the fortress could be taken over during the process of dismantling a building, and the dismantled building might not disappear and become unusable.
4.Fixed a bug that would prompt "you can't research the same technology twice" under certain circumstances when researching technology.
5.Fixed a bug that displayed the incorrect status when a commissioned fortress is attacked.
6.Added a right-click function to the group interface. Right-clicking on an idle general will individually replenish the troops for that general, and right-clicking on a general with troops will individually disband the troops of that general.
7.When the durability of the city walls is below 30%, the additional consumption of grain and fodder coefficient has been adjusted from 1.5 to 1.35. When it is above 30%, there will no longer be additional consumption of grain and fodder.
8.The farmland production has been adjusted from +25 points per level to +25, +30, +35, +40 points for levels 2 to 5, respectively.
9.The growth speed bonus for farmland reserves has been adjusted from +1% per level to +2% per level.
10.The attack power provided by arrow towers has been adjusted from +25 points per level to +25, +30, +35, +40 points for levels 2 to 5, respectively.
11.The random selection of Gong Sun Zan will not be available in the 189 year script.
12.The number of cities required for declaring emperor in the policy of "By the Heaven"has been adjusted from -5 to -2.
13.Fixed a bug that could cause the client to crash.
14.It will now be impossible to see rooms in different servers.

Upcoming Updates

Our programmers have resumed work and the diplomacy module has been resumed. You can declare friendship with other factions to gain a temporary ally, but friendly relations are not alliance relations. The other party can always break the agreement and sneak into your rear, but of course he will also receive a treacherous debuff. You can also invite others to send troops to a designated faction, thus reducing your own pressure or implementing the strategy of driving the tiger to swallow the wolf. In addition, you can establish a truce with warring enemy factions. For 2V2 and 4V4 modes, diplomacy can request resources from allies, which can be copper coins, grain, or grass, and can also mark the attack and defense instructions of cities on the map to facilitate allies' understanding of your strategic intentions. We hope this game can bring you fun, which is also the original intention of our development of this game. Please stay tuned.

notes.title: Special notice: Our programmers have a fever, bug fixes will be delayed
notes.content:
Dear players, hello:

Due to the sudden high fever of our team's programmers starting yesterday, the bug fix content originally planned to be updated this Friday may be postponed to next week. The diplomatic module under development will also be delayed,Due to the inability to fix the bug in a timely manner, it has caused a bad gaming experience for everyone. We deeply apologize.

This game is only developed by two programmers, one in charge of server development and the other in charge of client development. On Friday, the client program had a fever, and currently no one can help fix some known issues.

The bugs we are currently aware of include:

1. When demolishing a building too quickly, it may cause the building to not disappear and become inoperable

2. The problem of the city being beaten during the construction process, and the ongoing buildings not disappearing and unable to be operated

3. The issue of incorrect display of commission status after the city being commissioned is attacked

4. There is no issue of cities being attacked but displaying a reminder of being attacked

If the above problems occur, you can solve them by restarting the game. Restarting the game will not cause the game to end. Therefore, it is recommended to reduce the number of home demolitions in the current version, or slow down the demolitions, not too fast, to avoid frequent occurrences of this problem.

Thank you for your understanding and support! I also hope that this game can make you feel happy while playing. If you have any needs or questions, you can leave feedback in the discussion area or join the official Discord discussion. Thank you.

Youshen Interactive Sanguo's Ambiton 4 Development Team Respectfully

notes.title: 2023.11.3PLAYTEST版本补丁更新
notes.content:
